title: Onboarding: one setup per machine, clear failures
goal: Make installing and using CodeArts lanes as easy as possible for a new user on any harness: one prompt, one keys form, then any repo works; wrong keys explained in seconds; a first-run dashboard that says what to do.

waves.name: Wave 1 · Setup scope, keys, first-run page
waves.note: Contract checks written first (checks/scope.check.mjs, checks/authfast.check.mjs). No shared files except a small route in ca.mjs (keys and firstrun touch different parts).

lanes.why: Machine-wide setup by default, Codex MCP always written, smoke test outside the user's repo
Rejected AK/SK or MaaS key ends the lane in seconds with a plain message; MaaS key verified on save; readable doctor
First-run dashboard: one setup prompt, how to ask for work, Connect keys button, readable rows, no overflow

next: Merge the three lanes, run every check on master
Real fresh-user rerun: npm pack install in a fake home, onboard for claude and codex, smoke test, wrong-key run
Update README, INSTALL.md, docs/manual-setup.md and docs/workflow.md for machine-wide setup
Deploy to the live skill, push master to origin main

decisions.text: Fresh-user walkthrough found: smoke repo created inside the user's repo, Codex MCP never written by onboard, wrong keys look like an IAM outage and retry for 70 s, doctor table unreadable, first-run panel glued rows and overflow, setup needed again in every repo.
User chose machine-wide setup by default (--repo-only keeps the per-repo files).

risks: Kiro, Cursor and VS Code user-level paths come from their docs; they cannot be signed in here to test.
Writing ~/.claude.json directly races with a running Claude Code; the claude CLI is preferred.
